faq.title: Before you send the invites.
faq.description: Clear rules, from the first guest to the last scan.

items.q: Do I get 50 free QRs for every event?
items.a: No. Each workspace receives 50 complimentary QRs once, for its lifetime. Free allows one event in total. Deleting an event does not reset either allowance.
Your first approved QR purchase unlocks Personal, including unlimited events and custom PDF invitations. There is no subscription or monthly fee.

items.q: Can I save purchased QRs for later?
items.a: Yes. Purchased credits never expire, but belong to the event selected at checkout and cannot transfer. Creating a ticket uses one credit. Downloading, editing or restoring that same ticket does not use another. Canceling a ticket does not refund credit.

items.q: What happens without an internet connection?
items.a: Download the event on each scanner first. A valid offline access permit is required. Scans are saved locally and sync when connectivity returns. Two disconnected devices can accept the same ticket; Tiqra records the conflict when they reconnect. New cancellations reach devices on sync.

items.q: How are Argentine peso payments calculated?
items.a: Each extra ticket is priced in pesos using DolarAPI’s official rate. Checkout locks the final peso amount in a quote valid for 15 minutes. Credits become available only after payment approval through Mercado Pago.

items.q: Can I use my own invitation design?
items.a: Image and text invitations are included on Free. Personal adds one saved single-page PDF template per event, up to 10 MB. Drag or use the keyboard to position a fixed 5 × 5 cm QR footprint. Reserve that much clear space: the QR has an opaque white background.
